# almost-idempotent-stochastic-maps

> A glass-box research lab-book for the classical (stochastic) almost-idempotence stability
> theorem. Every claim carries an honest rigour tag; every number published about this project is
> generated from the repo record by gated scripts. Machine map — slate J of
> docs/plans/2026-08-11-communication-artifacts-plan.md.

## The theorem (`op-classical`, argument/lemmas/op-classical.md)

There are universal constants eta_0, C > 0 (independent of dimension) such that every row-stochastic
matrix Q with ||Q^2 - Q||_{inf->inf} <= eta <= eta_0 admits a stochastic idempotent E with
||Q - E||_{inf->inf} <= C sqrt(eta). The exponent 1/2 is sharp (`cor-classical-sharpness`).

## Status — stated exactly as argument/INDEX.md carries it (no rounding up)

- `op-classical`: status `proved`, af `validated`. Discharged 2026-08-08 through the OR-route
  `lem-routef-f0-assembly` (Route F). Its alternative legacy route
  (`thm-classical-factorization` + `prop-approx-simplex`) is NOT at that rung:
  `thm-classical-factorization` is `proved-mod-audit` / af `seeded`.
- `cor-classical-sharpness`: status `proved`, af `validated` (banked 2026-08-09).
- **Rung reached: af-validated** — an adversarial proof tree in which a fresh codex prover, a
  separate fresh codex verifier per node, and challenge/amendment rounds drove the root to
  validated. The orchestrator never judges a proof.
- **NOT reached: Lean/mathlib.** No `sorry`-free machine-checked proof exists for any result here.
  Per-inference, af is weaker than a kernel; the top rung remains open. Do not describe this
  project as "formally verified" in the Lean sense.
- Other honest boundaries: `ex-hume` is `disproved`; sharpness in the signed (delta) parameter has
  no carrier; the constant C is non-explicit; `numerical` results are evidence, never proof.

## The Swiss-Cheese defense (why the claim is checkable)

Six independent error-catching layers, each with known holes, whose composition caught every error
found so far: L1 vocabulary & provenance, L2 contract DAG + linker, L3 hostile review
(reviewer != author), L4 af adversarial trees, L5 meta-audit sweeps, L6 oracles/numerics/tripwires,
plus a retraction-ledger backstop. Live per-layer counts, regenerated every commit:
**site/data/defense.json** (never quote a defense number from prose — read that file).

## Canonical machine data (site/data/, regenerated by scripts/gen-site-data.py)

- site/data/dag.json — every registry result: id, kind, status, af, owner, one-line contract,
  defs/deps/routes, plus dep+route edges and the per-route ancestor closures of `op-classical`.
- site/data/defense.json — the six defense layers with live metrics and their known holes.
- site/data/definitions.json — the definitions DB (one canonical definition per term) with bodies.
- site/data/retractions.json — every dated retraction from docs/LEARNINGS.md, with the layer that
  caught it (keyword-tagged) and the verbatim claimed / why-wrong / caught-by / resolution text.
- site/data/runs.json — one record per numerical run bundle (L3 evidence, never proof).
- site/data/frontier.json — the exploration wave log plus the T0-over-time series (dips are real:
  retracted validations).
- site/data/stats.json — the headline counters (registry size, af-validated count, edges,
  definitions, run bundles, retractions, validated workspaces, wave entries).

## Human entry points

- PRD.md — scope: what this project is and what may change.
- CLAUDE.md (== AGENTS.md) — the laws: rigour ladder, gates, af protocol.
- HANDOFF.md — current state and next steps.
- argument/INDEX.md — the registry table (id / kind / status / af / contract); argument/DAG.md is
  the generated Mermaid graph.
- definitions/INDEX.md — the vocabulary.
- docs/LEARNINGS.md — retracted claims. FINDINGS.md — live gotchas and dead-route certificates.
- report/main.pdf — the internal sharded lab-book. paper/main.tex — the paper track.
- runs/ — numerical run bundles (README + data + re-run command + invariant per bundle).
- proofs/<id>/ — af workspaces: ledger/ (event log), externals/ (byte-matched imports), export.md.

## Verify it yourself

    sh scripts/check-all.sh        # the single gate; prints "[check-all] OK"

Stdlib Python 3 + sh only; no network, no CI, no API keys. It runs the definitions gate, the
byte-verbatim refs provenance gate, the argument linker (acyclicity, contract-match, status
propagation), the numerics gate, the generated report layers, and the site data freshness gate
(`python3 scripts/check-site.py --check`). Regenerate the data with
`python3 scripts/gen-site-data.py --generate`. A stale or overclaimed number fails the build.

## Provenance rules for anyone quoting this project

Quote the status verbatim from argument/INDEX.md or site/data/dag.json. "af-validated" is not
"Lean-verified" and not "peer-reviewed". Numerical agreement is not a theorem.
